mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over three months signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL is above 2% YoY, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% coupled with a rising PAYEMS signals a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over three months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases > 10% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) growth rate below 2% YoY signals a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% during a late-cycle expansion.
